description: This file contains extension methods for the OnboardingView class, managing user interactions during onboarding including gateway selection, navigation, settings, and clipboard copying.

methods.name: selectLocalGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to local and resets gateway preferences.

methods.name: selectUnconfiguredGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to unconfigured and resets gateway preferences, cancelling any ongoing onboarding wizard process.

methods.name: selectRemoteGateway
methods.description: Configures the app to connect to a specified remote gateway, updating preferences and coordinating with other components.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Requests opening the specified settings tab and posts a notification to update UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Navigates back in onboarding pages with animation.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next onboarding page or finishes the process if at the end.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks onboarding as seen, saves version info, and closes onboarding controller.

methods.name: copyToPasteboard
methods.description: Copies a given string to the system clipboard and temporarily indicates success.
